development_set_leakage_investigation.scientific_assessment: CONFIRMED IN-SAMPLE DEVELOPMENT OVERLAP: All 4 diagnostic false negatives used to design V2's corporate suffix normalization, locality extraction, and event qualifier rules belong to Dataset C (benchmark_human_verified_v1.csv). Therefore, evaluating V2 on Dataset C represents development-set diagnostic evaluation rather than independent generalization. The reported improvement in strict recall (0.9070 -> 0.9302) reflects training-set error reduction. To maintain scientific integrity, V2 must NOT be claimed superior until evaluated on an untouched, out-of-sample test partition.
development_set_leakage_investigation.scientific_claim_restriction: STRICT EMBARGO: V2 is strictly restricted to EXPERIMENTAL prototype status. No claim of model superiority over V1 may be asserted in documentation or research publications based on Dataset C.
